title: Letter arrival editor
description: Magnetic keyframes set when three original letterforms arrive, with a scrubber and a live preview of the edited timing.
useCase: Synchronizing independent text or graphic entrances with an immediately inspectable animation consequence.
interaction: Align the arrival diamonds, scrub the ruler, then preview the animation
reducedMotion: Scrubbing shows discrete arrived/not-arrived letter states without translation; Preview becomes an End frame action. A live preference change cancels playback.
limitations: Three authored letterform arrivals in a 1.6-second local composition. Each entrance lasts 300 ms and ends at its diamond; no general animation engine or export. Host pause freezes and resumes the current time.
look: Violet band with large pale block letters above a dark aubergine timeline: three tracks with purple bars, diamond keyframes, a monospace ruler and white playhead.
motion: Letters rise into place with cubic ease-out during the 0.3 s before their keyframes; dragged diamonds snap together within 0.045 s; a button plays the 1.6 s timeline.
adapt: Letter motion is computed in render from `time` and `frames` (cubic ease-out over 0.3 s per letter); `update` applies the 0.045 magnetic snap (Alt bypasses) and a `requestAnimationFrame` loop plays to `END`. Replace `outlines` and `letters` with your tracks.
